title: Skeleton Queen of Cinema
description: A skeletal queen with long flowing golden hair and a floral crown sits on an ornate purple throne, holding a film reel and chain. Skeletons march in a line from a shattered golden picture frame on the right, while a film strip of dancing skeletons curves across the starry magenta sky.
prompt: A skeletal queen wearing a crown of pink roses and a flowing white and purple gown sits on a purple throne, long golden hair flowing behind her. She holds a film reel attached to a chain. A procession of dancing skeletons emerges from a broken golden picture frame on the right. A film strip showing skeletons dances across a swirling magenta and green starry sky. Large pink and white peonies surround the throne, scattered petals on the floor, surreal fantasy style.
